text: Dear Professor Smith, / Dear Sir or Madam,
I am a senior majoring in Chinese Literature at this university, and I am writing this letter with the aim of offering some constructive suggestions to improve the library service.

After serious consideration, the emphasis is laid on the following three points. In the first place, it would be highly appreciated if the administration could prolong the opening hours during examination weeks. In the second place, it is advisable for the library to introduce more power outlets and silent study cubicles. Lastly, regular book maintenance should be strengthened to ensure timely access to academic references.
Thank you for your due attention to this matter, and I would be willing to provide further details if required. I am looking forward to your favorable response at your earliest convenience.
